mechanism_narrative: A rising FEDFUNDS rate above 5.5% in the current month predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened near-term discounting of equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >70% of FEDFUNDS > 5.5% events, or FEDFUNDS decline occurs without SPX decline.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, labor market slack increases, boosting investor confidence and driving a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of UNRATE < 3.5% events, or unemployment rises sharply without SPX gain.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in HOUST (household spending) by more than 2% month-over-month predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as strong consumer demand supports corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are flat or negative when HOUST growth exceeds 2% and economic data show weak corporate profits.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 1.5% for three months indicates supply-side weakness, which is associated with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of INDPRO contraction periods, or INDPRO recovers without SPX decline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL by at least 0.2% each month for two months signals dual pressure on rates and prices, predicting a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < prev and CPIAUCSL < prev for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when both proxies decline, or the interaction effect rank IC > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in PAYEMS (employment) by over 50,000 in a month coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market absorption supports optimism about corporate growth.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are flat or negative when PAYEMS increases by <10,000, or unemployment falls without SPX gain.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) exceeds 2% above its 3-month moving average for two consecutive months, it indicates resilient demand, leading to a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of RSAFS above MA events, or retail sales miss expectations despite SPX rise.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged monthly decline in GDPC1 (GDP) of 1% or more for four consecutive months suggests economic softening, which is associated with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive when GDPC1 declines for <4 months, or GDP recovers without SPX drop.
